today_summary: GCM26 prints $4,383.7, -$40.9 (-0.92%) and the first lower close after four straight higher ones, with ATM IV grinding to a five-day low of 21.56% (-0.53pp) and a 1-sigma day of just $59.5 (1.36%) - the tightest of the week. Net GEX within +/-$200 fell +247.3 -> +168.9 (-32%), and the split is the story: above-spot gamma holds +254.1 while sub-spot gamma doubled its negative print to -85.1 from -43.1, so the cushion is entirely overhead and the trapdoor underneath got deeper. The $4,500 call wall added another +61 to 12,267 contracts - its fifth consecutive build and the largest strike in the +/-25% window - sitting $116 overhead as a dealer-damped ceiling. Total volume collapsed to 5,099 calls / 2,785 puts, the lowest of the five sessions, and the heaviest call print was $7,000 (891) - lottery paper, not positioning.
five_day_thesis: Spot is up $4,332.6 -> $4,383.7 (+$51.1, +1.18%) over five sessions, but the floor beneath it was dismantled while the ceiling was reinforced. Near-money put support was withdrawn and pushed down and out - $4,250 -520, $4,200 -355, $4,300 -79 - while crash strikes were funded: $3,700 +813, $3,950 +444, $3,500 +301, leaving the $4,200-$4,300 shelf the thinnest it has been all week just as spot rolls back toward it. Call adds went the same way, away from the market rather than into it: $8,000 +893, $5,000 +477, $7,000 +372 and $5,100 +284 were bought while $5,500 -497, $4,900 -348 and $6,000 -280 were retired, and the $4,500 wall ground up 12,108 -> 12,267 every single session. ATM IV compressed 23.74% -> 21.56% (-2.18pp) and the 1-sigma day shrank $64.8 -> $59.5, so the market is paying less for protection precisely as the sub-spot gamma profile deteriorated from -43.1 to -85.1. The gamma flip has been pinned at $4,680-$4,725 all week and sits $316 overhead, while max pain drifted $5,570 -> $5,500 (-$70) but at +$1,116 (+25.5%) above spot remains legacy deep-OTM call stock, not a tradable magnet.
